v1.35 MediaMTX AOM AV1 RTMP / WHIP / HLS 兼容记录 / Compatibility record
==================================================================

Project version: v1.35. Commands, paths and verification values below are shared
by both languages. Dated validation records are preserved from that verification;
this documentation review does not claim a new runtime test or attestation run.

Bundled source base and custom version:
  MediaMTX v1.21.0
  upstream commit 2c6727904fbf233615de74a6c54a9b94dbf6025d
  custom build version v1.21.0-r11

Patched dependency base:
  github.com/bluenviron/gortmplib v1.0.2
  upstream commit fbafd129baf54d49a2e3243f620d738ed72ff82e

Toolchain and dependency graph:
  Go 1.27.1 with GOTOOLCHAIN=local. The r11 version patch pins this Go
  baseline. Use the exact included MediaMTX-go.mod
  and MediaMTX-go.sum, whose gortmplib replacement points to a sibling tree.
  Preserve the current x/crypto v0.56.0 security floor. Other upstream versions include gohlslib v2.4.4,
  mediacommon v2.9.4, gortsplib v5.6.5 and Pion WebRTC v4.2.19.

Required patch order (after cloning the exact source commits):
  gortmplib:
    gortmplib-v1.0.2-av1-empty-sequence-start.patch
  MediaMTX:
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-av1-whip-hls.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-av1-valid-test-fixtures.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-r11-version.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-go1.27-test-isolation.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-webrtc-local-candidate-priority.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-whip-rtp-reorder-512.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-whip-reorder-regressions.patch
    mediamtx-v1.21.0-hlsjs-1.7.3.patch

Compatibility behavior retained:
  1. Accept the five-byte AV1 Enhanced RTMP sequence-start placeholder, then
     wait for a later valid av1C before configuring the track. The change is
     AV1-specific; malformed nonempty AV1 configs still fail, and upstream's
     newer H264/H265 parameter checks remain intact.
  2. Normalize AV1 OBU internal sizes only when LEB128 length exactly matches
     the supplied payload. Normalize base-layer extension headers, reject
     invalid header/extension bits and enhancement layers, and filter temporal
     delimiters. Retain the narrowly matched libdatachannel missing-base-header
     compatibility form used by the existing OBS/AOM path.
  3. Cache a successfully parsed sequence header and restore it only before
     an actual KEY_FRAME if the sender omitted it. Do not prepend it to inter
     frames or show-existing-frame units. gohlslib v2.4.4 and mediacommon v2.9.4
     still recognize AV1 random access through sequence-header presence, so
     this AOM compatibility behavior remains necessary.
  4. Keep valid FRAME OBU fixtures instead of reserved type-0 arbitrary bytes.
     Keep fixed-port WHIP auth tests isolated from stale HTTP idle connections.
     These changes affect tests, not production authentication.
  5. Keep configured private/loopback/link-local additional ICE hosts above
     configured public hosts in priority and preserve their configured order.
     No new interfaces, permitted clients or listening ports are introduced.
     The public WHEP gateway independently filters candidates: public requesters
     receive only startup-approved PUBLIC_HOST IPv4 addresses. Eligible private,
     loopback or link-local IPv4 requesters may also receive the exact configured
     WHIP_IP; other local addresses remain excluded.
  6. Keep video RTP reordering and SRTP replay protection at the bounded
     512-packet window. SRTP authentication and replay rejection remain enabled.
     gortsplib v5.6.5 still defaults to 64; audio reordering uses its default.

Current upstream integration:
  None of the retained compatibility/runtime fixes is upstreamed in v1.21.0
  or gortmplib v1.0.2. No MoQ teardown test patch is needed for the current
  upstream test server. It ignores terminal session/write errors in that fixture.
  Existing
  received-payload, source-info, authentication-format and fingerprint-error
  tests remain and must be run. Production MoQ authentication is not relaxed
  by the project compatibility patches.

  v1.21.0 adds RTX codec registration for incoming video; retain that upstream
  addition and its negotiation tests. Pion returns repaired packets with their
  original sequence number, payload type and SSRC, so delayed RTX packets still
  need the MediaMTX reorder window. RTX requires publisher support and does not
  guarantee loss-free operation under arbitrary network impairment.

  v1.21.0's allowed-origin scheme/dot matching, Origin reflection/Vary header
  and empty default API/metrics/pprof origin lists are untouched by these patches.
  CORS is separate from authentication and must not replace the project ACL,
  public route allowlist, loopback bindings or WHEP ownership checks.

Embedded HLS library:
  hls.js v1.7.3, identical to the project's unchanged npm asset.
  asset SHA-256:
    a12e7ee1cd64a69dcdb314157e45dafcba705bfb0b1440b7935cb265d374423e
  official GitHub release.zip SHA-256 pinned by the generator patch:
    abbda85f3e9b8325fc6b8dbf4fa612ea87144ebad93c2150594e64aad58ec529
  Build by copying web/hls.min.js to internal/servers/hls/hls.min.js and only
  generating the rpicamera asset. The generator's VERSION and HASH are also
  updated, so later HLS regeneration stays on v1.7.3. Do not run the core
  version getter after applying the custom version patch.

RTP and security regression fixture:
  Project input: tests/fixtures/whip-av1-sequences.bin
  Copy before MediaMTX tests to:
    internal/protocols/webrtc/testdata/whip-av1-sequences.bin
  SHA-256: dbd953ce8b7372c6ffbf197c34158238517af0abd98a23a0cf6bea3d3b90c9e9
  The input records the prior real AV1 WHIP packet arrival order: 126869 unique
  packets, 202 duplicates, wraparound and reordering up to 101 packets.
  TestInboundReorderCapturedWHIP requires complete ordered delivery with zero
  loss and expected duplicate rejection under AES128-CM/HMAC-SHA1-80 and
  AEAD-AES128-GCM. Old replays and fresh-sequence tampered ciphertext must fail;
  a valid packet with that fresh sequence must then succeed, and its replay fail.
  The existing preserve-real-gaps case now fills inboundRTPReorderWindow while
  keeping its +2 missing-sequence assertion.

Encoder requirement:
  HLS/CMAF still needs real random-access frames; keep the existing OBS keyframe
  interval of 1-2 seconds. The server does not transcode or create key frames.

Provenance and current validation (2026-09-12):
  Exact official source tag commits and clean patch application were checked.
  Both official v1.21.0 Linux amd64/arm64 release artifacts passed GitHub CLI
  2.100.0 attestation verification with the exact source commit/ref, release
  workflow and GitHub-hosted-runner policy. The verified Rekor timestamp is
  2026-09-06T05:28:38+08:00. See MediaMTX-v1.21.0-UPSTREAM-ATTESTATION.txt for
  verified subject hashes and identity; these official attestations do not
  certify the custom patched binaries as upstream release artifacts.

  Complete MediaMTX normal and race suites each passed 1,226 test/subtest runs.
  Complete patched gortmplib normal and race suites each passed 426 runs.
  MediaMTX vet passed. The captured WHIP sequence replay passed both SRTP
  profiles: 126869 delivered, zero lost, 202 duplicate rejections per profile.
  No executed tests were skipped; JSON skip events were packages without tests.
  Full upstream suites used an isolated mount/network namespace with a local
  STUN responder and multicast route. Initial route/STUN fixture failures were
  corrected without changing assertions. The local fixture does not validate
  Google STUN reachability or public NAT traversal.

  The upgraded compiled helper and Caddy passed 115/115 security boundary checks
  against a controlled media backend; the project JavaScript suite passed
  124/124. Real systemd-nspawn acceptance passed 101/101 checks with the actual
  upgraded MediaMTX and systemd services: installation and restart were each
  observed stable for 152 seconds, including authentication, ingest ACL,
  listener, stop and retained-credential checks. The final container fixture
  used a container-only trusted CA/leaf after a cold public-certificate fixture
  waited on unavailable OCSP/DNS access; certificate verification stayed enabled
  and production certificates were unchanged. These lifecycle checks do not
  establish real encoded-media continuity. Live weak-network playback acceptance
  and remaining coverage limits are recorded in the accompanying upgrade report.

Vulnerability audit (2026-09-12):
  govulncheck v1.8.0 used Go 1.27.1 and the database updated at
  2026-09-10T14:48:42Z. The MediaMTX executable entry (.) source scan reported
  one module-only finding: GO-2026-5932 in x/crypto v0.56.0. It reported no
  affected imported package or callable-symbol finding at that entry.
  Each amd64/arm64 binary scan retained module/package/symbol findings for
  GO-2026-5932, the unmaintained OpenPGP API advisory with no fixed version
  in this database. They are not zero-warning binaries. Binary symbol matches
  alone do not establish a runtime call path. JSON-mode scan exit 0 only records
  completion and must not be substituted for parsing the finding records.

Bundled binary SHA-256:
  amd64  d2a1acd4296d1d41443007069eff85bc622a865cbc169e5e752bdfdcc083b292
  arm64  c7e91886e84ba890c648f8b1c89dda624ed8ad1b1a516ef96a34925459b44b99

Reproducibility:
  Both MediaMTX architectures were rebuilt from the same source/module graph
  and generated assets with a fresh GOCACHE. Each matched the bundled bytes
  (cmp exit 0). The build used Go 1.27.1, GOTOOLCHAIN=local, CGO disabled,
  -mod=readonly, -trimpath, -buildvcs=false, -p 4 and
  -ldflags='-s -w -buildid='. BUILDING.md contains the complete commands.

Licenses:

中文说明（与上文共用固定提交、补丁顺序和校验值）
================================================

版本、源码与工具链：
  本项目版本为 v1.35。MediaMTX 源码为 v1.21.0、实际定制二进制标识为
  v1.21.0-r11；gortmplib 源码为 v1.0.2。两者的准确上游提交见上文。
  使用 Go 1.27.1 和 GOTOOLCHAIN=local，r11 补丁固定该 Go 基线。随包的
  MediaMTX-go.mod/go.sum 是精确依赖图，gortmplib replace 指向同级源码目录。
  必须保留当前 x/crypto v0.56.0 安全基线。
  其他当前依赖包括 gohlslib v2.4.4、mediacommon v2.9.4、gortsplib v5.6.5、
  Pion WebRTC v4.2.19。克隆并核对固定提交后，严格按上文顺序应用全部补丁。

保留的兼容行为：
  1. 接受五字节 AV1 Enhanced RTMP sequence-start 占位符，等后续有效 av1C
     到达后再配置轨道。变更只作用于 AV1；非空但损坏的 AV1 配置仍拒绝，
     上游 H264/H265 参数检查保持完整。
  2. 仅当 LEB128 长度与实际载荷完全相等时归一化 AV1 OBU 内部长度；归一化基础层
     扩展头，拒绝非法头/扩展位和增强层，并过滤时间分隔符。保留现有 OBS/AOM
     路径使用的、严格匹配的 libdatachannel 缺基础头兼容格式。
  3. 缓存成功解析的序列头；仅当发送方省略序列头且单元确为 KEY_FRAME 时补回。
     不对帧间帧或 show-existing-frame 单元前置序列头。当前 gohlslib 和
     mediacommon 仍用序列头是否存在识别 AV1 随机访问，因此仍需要此 AOM 兼容。
  4. 使用有效 FRAME OBU 测试数据，避免保留类型 0 的任意字节；固定端口 WHIP
     鉴权测试隔离残留 HTTP 空闲连接。这些修改只影响测试，不改变生产鉴权。
  5. 配置中的私有/回环/链路本地附加 ICE 地址优先于配置的公网地址，并保持配置
     顺序；不新增接口、允许的客户端或监听端口。公网 WHEP 网关另行过滤候选：
     公网请求者仅收到启动时已批准的 PUBLIC_HOST IPv4；符合条件的私有、回环或
     链路本地 IPv4 请求者还可收到精确配置的 WHIP_IP，其他本地地址仍排除。
  6. 视频 RTP 重排与 SRTP 防重放均保持有界 512 包窗口；SRTP 鉴权和重放拒绝
     继续启用。gortsplib 默认仍为 64 包，音频重排使用上游默认值。

当前上游整合：
  这些兼容/运行时修复尚未合入 MediaMTX v1.21.0 或 gortmplib v1.0.2。
  当前上游 MoQ 测试服务器无需 teardown 补丁；夹具忽略终止会话/写入错误，
  接收载荷、来源信息、鉴权格式和指纹错误测试仍保留并必须运行。项目兼容补丁
  没有放宽生产 MoQ 鉴权。
  MediaMTX v1.21.0 新增的入站视频 RTX 编解码器注册及协商测试保留。Pion 将
  修复包恢复为原序列号、载荷类型和 SSRC，延迟 RTX 包仍需要重排窗口。
  RTX 依赖推流端支持，不能保证任意弱网条件下零丢包。
  上游 allowed-origin 的 scheme/点匹配、Origin 反射/Vary 响应头，以及 API、
  metrics、pprof 的默认空 Origin 列表均未修改。CORS 独立于鉴权，不能替代
  项目 ACL、公网路由白名单、回环绑定或 WHEP 会话归属检查。

内嵌 HLS 库：
  hls.js v1.7.3 与项目未修改的 npm 资源完全一致。上文分别列出运行资源 SHA-256
  和生成器补丁固定的官方 GitHub release.zip SHA-256，不能混用。
  将 web/hls.min.js 复制到 internal/servers/hls/hls.min.js，仅生成 rpicamera
  资源；生成器 VERSION/HASH 也已更新，使日后 HLS 生成仍固定 v1.7.3。
  应用定制版本补丁后不要再次运行核心版本生成器。

RTP 与安全回归样本：
  输入 tests/fixtures/whip-av1-sequences.bin 须在测试前复制到上文 testdata 路径。
  SHA-256 见上文。该样本记录真实 AV1 WHIP 到达顺序：126869 个唯一包、202 个
  重复包，包含回绕及最大 101 包乱序。TestInboundReorderCapturedWHIP 在
  AES128-CM/HMAC-SHA1-80 和 AEAD-AES128-GCM 下要求完整有序交付、零丢包并
  正确拒绝重复包。旧包重放和新序列号篡改密文必须失败；同一新序列号的有效包
  随后必须成功，其再次重放必须失败。真实缺包用例填满 inboundRTPReorderWindow，
  继续检查 +2 缺失序列断言。

编码器要求：
  HLS/CMAF 仍需真实随机访问帧；OBS 关键帧间隔保持 1–2 秒。服务端不转码，
  也不会生成关键帧。

来源与验证记录（2026-09-12）：
  已核对官方源码标签提交及补丁干净应用。官方 v1.21.0 Linux amd64/arm64
  发行包均通过 GitHub CLI 2.100.0 来源证明验证，约束准确提交/ref、发行工作流
  和 GitHub 托管 runner。核验的 Rekor 时间戳为 2026-09-06T05:28:38+08:00。
  详细主体哈希和签名身份见 MediaMTX-v1.21.0-UPSTREAM-ATTESTATION.txt；
  上游证明不把本项目定制二进制认证为官方发行包。
  完整 MediaMTX 普通和 race 套件各通过 1,226 个测试/子测试；完整修补版
  gortmplib 普通和 race 套件各通过 426 个；MediaMTX vet 通过。捕获 WHIP
  序列回放在两种 SRTP 配置下均交付 126869 包、零丢失并拒绝 202 个重复包。
  没有跳过已执行用例；JSON skip 事件对应没有测试文件的包。完整上游测试使用
  隔离挂载/网络命名空间、本地 STUN 响应器和多播路由；初次路由/STUN 夹具失败
  通过修正环境解决，没有修改断言。本地夹具不验证 Google STUN 或公网 NAT。
  升级后的实际 helper 和 Caddy 在受控媒体后端上通过 115/115 安全边界检查，
  项目 JavaScript 通过 124/124。实际 systemd-nspawn 环境使用升级后的 MediaMTX
  和 systemd 服务通过 101/101 检查；安装、重启各观察 152 秒稳定，覆盖鉴权、
  推流 ACL、监听、停止与凭据保留。冷启动公网证书夹具曾等待不可用 OCSP/DNS；
  最终使用只在容器内受信任的测试 CA/叶证书，证书验证保持启用，线上证书未变。
  生命周期检查不证明真实编码媒体连续性；实时弱网验收及覆盖限制见随附升级报告。
  本次文档整理不表示重新执行上述运行测试。

漏洞审计记录（2026-09-12）：
  govulncheck v1.8.0 使用 Go 1.27.1 和更新至 2026-09-10T14:48:42Z 的数据库。
  MediaMTX 可执行入口（.）源码扫描仅报告 x/crypto v0.56.0 的模块级
  GO-2026-5932，没有受影响导入包或可调用符号发现。两个架构的二进制扫描仍有
  同一公告的模块/包/符号发现，即未维护 OpenPGP API 的公告，数据库没有修复版本。
  不能称为零警告二进制；单凭符号匹配不能证明运行时调用路径；JSON 模式退出 0
  仅表示扫描完成，必须读取发现记录判定结果。

二进制与可重现性：
  上文 amd64/arm64 SHA-256 对应实际随包二进制。两个架构以相同源码、依赖图、
  生成资源和全新 GOCACHE 重建，均逐字节相同（cmp 退出 0）。参数为 Go 1.27.1、
  GOTOOLCHAIN=local、禁用 CGO、-mod=readonly、-trimpath、-buildvcs=false、
  -p 4 和 -ldflags='-s -w -buildid='；完整命令见 BUILDING.md。

许可证：
  MediaMTX-LICENSE.txt 和 gortmplib-LICENSE.txt，法律文本保持原样。
